title: CA Article Assistant
summary: A CA article assistant is a chartered accountancy student doing the compulsory practical training at a CA firm after clearing CA Intermediate and ICITSS (the institute's IT and orientation course). They work under seniors and partners on statutory and tax audit fieldwork, GST, TDS and income-tax returns, and bookkeeping for clients.
dailyDuties: Do vouching and verification of bills and ledgers on audit fieldwork
Prepare GST returns and reconcile input tax credit for clients
Compute TDS and prepare quarterly TDS returns
Prepare income-tax computations and returns for individuals and firms
Post entries and pull reports in Tally for bookkeeping clients
Prepare audit schedules and working papers for review

skills.expectation: Apply accounting standards and prepare reconciliations from CA Intermediate study
Do vouching and verification on audit fieldwork under a senior
Prepare GST returns and compute TDS for client filings
Compute income and prepare income-tax returns for individuals and firms
Post vouchers and pull ledgers and reports in Tally
Prepare audit schedules and tax workings in Excel
Ask clients for documents and explain queries clearly
Prepare working papers that a manager can review
Prepare tax audit annexures and Form 3CD clauses
Prepare quarterly TDS returns and download certificates
Prepare audit schedules and follow up on client queries
Test controls on internal or concurrent audits
Help with ROC filings for company clients

certifications.why: Articleship firms audit and keep books for SME clients in Tally.
A recognised GST credential to show alongside CA studies.
